Following the rise of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Knight]] [[Jax Pavan]] armed himself with various weapons. Among them was a '''[[Vibroknife/Legends|vibroknife]]''', which he kept in a sheath between his shoulder blades. It was the only publicly visible weapon on him. He handed the knife briefly to [[Den Dhur]] to fight off the [[Feral droid|feral]] [[Droid/Legends|droids]] in the [[Factory District]] and shortly later Pavan used it to destroy the droid [[10-4TO]] "Bug-Eyes."<ref name="CNI:JT" /> Following the [[Ambush near the Twins|ambush]] near the [[Twins (star system)/Legends|Twins]], Jax Pavan escaped the crashing [[Far Ranger]] with only his [[Jax Pavan's third lightsaber|third lightsaber]], [[Aurra Sing/Legends|Aurra Sing's]] old [[Aurra Sing's lightsaber|lightsaber]], his [[Miisai|miisai tree]] and the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Sith holocron/Legends|holocron]] [[SD41263.I]].<ref name="Last Jedi">[[The Last Jedi (novel)|''The Last Jedi'']]</ref>
